remarks: Welcome to your dream home beautifully sited on almost 2 acres with a pool, spa and flat back yard for enjoying the surrounding peace and serenity. Located minutes from New Canaan's vibrant downtown, renowned for its exceptional schools and community, this fabulous 5-bedroom center hall colonial exudes elegance and charm at every turn. Step into the gracious foyer with a sweeping staircase and views through the music room to the sparkling pool and large flagstone deck. The high ceilings and expansive rooms are flooded with natural light and create an inviting atmosphere for both relaxing evenings at home and entertaining guests. The heart of the home is the gourmet kitchen, boasting top-of-the-line appliances, custom cabinetry and a center island perfect for culinary creations. Adjacent is a spacious family room featuring a cozy fireplace, vaulted ceiling and French doors leading to the picturesque terrace and views of the lush surroundings and vegetable garden. The formal rooms include an expansive dining room and library with western facing bay windows, perfect for enjoying magnificent sunsets from the home's elevated location. The spacious living room with built ins and a fireplace open to the private backyard and beautiful pool.  At the end of the day, retreat to the elegant primary bedroom to enjoy a sauna in the luxurious bathroom. At the top of the stairs is a sun-drenched room with French doors currently being used by the resident photographer as an office however
